elements.name: Vuetrex
elements.description: Root scene container. Import Vuetrex and place the scene in its default slot.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.description: Initial scene configuration. Read once at mount; remount with a new key to replace settings.

description-sections.All settings:
| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `number` | `0x555555` | Default node color. Zero currently falls back to the default. |
| `backgroundColor` | `number` | `0x808080` | Solid scene background color. |
| `mirrorOpacity` | `number` | `0.55` | Floor contribution over its reflection, clamped to 0–1. Lower values reveal more reflection; 1 skips the reflection pass. |
| `floorColor` | `number` | `0x3f3f3f` | Floor texture color. When omitted, the reflection tint separately defaults to 0x777777. |
| `floorFadeStart` | `number` | `undefined (disabled)` | World X/Z extent where floor fading begins. Set with floorFadeEnd; requires 0 <= start < end. Objects are unaffected. |
| `floorFadeEnd` | `number` | `undefined (disabled)` | World X/Z extent where the floor matches the background. For example, start 20 and end 50 preserve the central 40-by-40 area. |
| `highlightColor` | `number` | `0x4c7fb2` | Default interactive highlight color. Zero currently falls back to the default. |
| `connectorColor` | `number` | `0xa0ffff` | Default connector color. |
| `captionColor` | `number` | `0xffffff` | Floor caption and grid color. |
| `lightColor1` | `number` | `0xccffff` | First directional light color. Zero currently falls back to the default. |
| `lightColor2` | `number` | `0xffffff` | Second directional light color. Zero currently falls back to the default. |
| `lightColor3` | `number` | `undefined` | Currently unused: the stage does not create a third light. |
| `unit` | `number` | `1` | Base geometry unit in world units. Zero currently falls back to 1. |
| `gap` | `number` | `1` | Default container spacing in world units. |
| `fog` | `VxFogSettings` | `undefined (disabled)` | Linear camera-distance fog affecting the scene. Use floorFadeStart/floorFadeEnd to fade only the floor. |
| `diagnostics` | `boolean \| VxDiagnosticsSettings` | `false` | Enable all diagnostic overlays with true, or configure individual overlays. Omitted flags in an object are enabled. |
| `floorGrid` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw the floor grid. |
| `floorMirror` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable floor reflections. mirrorOpacity=1 also disables the reflection pass. |
| `floorCaptions` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw node captions on the floor. |
| `shadows` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable renderer shadow maps, shadow lights, and mesh shadow flags. |

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Wrapper CSS positioning mode.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Wrapper CSS height, including units (for example "520px" or "70vh").

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Wrapper CSS width, including units. The wrapper has a 4096px maximum width.

attributes.name: stopped
attributes.description: Pause rendering and stage animations. Changes take effect reactively.

attributes.name: sheets
attributes.description: Ordered style definitions for this scene. Overrides sheets inherited from a `vx-stylesheet` provider; changes apply reactively.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Color scheme for this scene. Overrides the scheme inherited from a `vx-stylesheet` provider; `system` follows the browser preference.

attributes.name: camera
attributes.description: Node name/ID, "scene" for automatic fitting, or { orbit } for an explicit initial pose. Applied before ready; reactive changes replace camera animation.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Currently unused by the renderer. Supply scene content through the default slot.

attributes.name: elements
attributes.description: Custom host constructors registered for this scene. Read once at mount.

events.name: ready
events.description:
Emitted once after stage mounting, before the inner scene tree mounts on the next Vue tick.
The payload provides the public stage controls; content bounds are not ready yet.

events.name: scene-error
events.description: Structured scene failure, emitted in development and production. Includes tag, optional node ID/property, phase, correction, and original cause.

events.name: composer-status
events.description: Emitted when the requested/effective composer plan or a fallback changes; never emitted per frame.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The scene tree rendered by Vuetrex. Required to create a stage.
